title: Satellite Tracker – Live Map of Starlink and 30k Satellites
summary: A real-time web-based satellite tracking visualization that displays Starlink and approximately 30,000 satellites on an interactive 3D globe, allowing users to monitor orbital positions and trajectories.
problem_solved: Provides public visibility into the rapidly growing satellite population in Earth orbit, making complex orbital tracking data accessible and visual.
why_valuable: democratizes space situational awareness by giving anyone with a browser the ability to track satellites in real-time, fostering greater transparency about our orbital environment.
